_comment: Code registry for conformance/operator/v1 (POST /authority/rebind/{plan,apply}, POST /authority/release-policy/{frame}/{plan,apply}, POST /release-catalog/{catalog}/{import,revoke}/{plan,apply}; scope lifecycle:operator), under the error envelope of ADR 0001. Each entry: the HTTP status, retryable, and the message clients see in error.message; the real reason for a refusal is in error.details.reason. Codes admission/v1, session/v1 and registration/v1 also list (stale_revision, authority_failed, operator_signature_required, config_unreadable, beadyard_mismatch, committed_unreadable, working_set_dirty, publish_busy, path_invalid, request_malformed, deadline_exceeded) keep their entries there. Normative, no Python wire reference: Python has no HTTP surface for these; the records are beadhive's (hq_control_plane.renew, frame_release_policy.prepare). Owned by the corpus, not either implementation.

rebind_invalid.message: the rebind request is not a frame and a duration in their forms

release_policy_invalid.message: the release policy request or its spec is invalid

operator_signature_invalid.message: the signature does not verify against the operator key over the plan's signing input

plan_expired.message: the plan is older than its window; plan again

plan_mismatch.message: the apply is not what the plan request yields

operator_state_invalid.message: the authority the operator would publish is invalid

rebind_no_frame_grant.message: the frame has no active or candidate grant to rebind

rebind_policy_unavailable.message: no single current frame policy revision is available to rebind the frame to

rebind_policy_ambiguous.message: managed hives carry different frame policy revisions

release_policy_no_grant.message: the frame has no active or candidate grant

release_policy_unchanged.message: the frame's release policy is already this

release_policy_downgrade.message: the range excludes the attested release while admitting lower ones

release_policy_reader_old.message: frames attest a release too old to read a release policy

release_policy_reader_unknown.message: frames have no attested release, so they may not read a release policy

operator_apply_disabled.message: this service does not write the authority table for operator publication

catalog_invalid.message: the catalog request is not a release and its provenance in their forms

catalog_row_exists.message: the catalog already holds this release active

catalog_version_taken.message: the version already has another active digest in the catalog

catalog_row_unknown.message: the catalog holds no active row for this release

catalog_row_revoked.message: the release is already revoked in the catalog
